Friend, Last week, I was proud to share with you that we landed a major bipartisan permitting deal that delivers for families in New Mexico and across the country. Since then, labor leaders, energy producers, nonprofits, business and manufacturing groups, and state and local government officials have had the chance to review the deal. The results are in... **And they love it.** It’s not hard to see why. The bill includes ideas from both parties in Congress and a wide range of stakeholders. | | **The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act** _“After years of working toward this goal, lawmakers from both parties have reached a deal to fix the broken system that keeps America from building the power plants and power lines that would bring costs down. This is a huge bipartisan win at a moment when our politics has made wins like this rare. Today, Congress is choosing differently.”_ \- Derek Kaufman, President of Inclusive Abundance Action _"If you care about decarbonizing the economy or reshoring American manufacturing, or cutting bills for ratepayers, then you should support this bill. No agreement is perfect, but there’s something in this permitting reform agreement that will, on net, benefit everybody. And there isn’t a better deal out there.”_ \- Jane Flegal and Pavan Venkatakrishnan of the Searchlight Institute _“...presents an incredible opportunity for clean energy, and we look forward to seeing it cross the finish line... is a generational opportunity to unleash American energy through faster infrastructure permitting and improved transmission planning.”_ \- Rich Powell, CEO, Clean Energy Buyers Association _“If America is going to meaningfully reduce our emissions and truly address climate change, we need to connect much more clean energy to the grid. This bill will make remarkable, rapid progress toward that goal. We’re proud to endorse it, and we’re excited to mobilize our grassroots volunteers in full support.”_ \- Rick Bradley, Citizens Climate Lobby’s Executive Director _“...will increase project certainty, streamline federal review timelines, and create thousands of good-paying jobs – all while maintaining reasonable environmental safeguards and opportunities for public input.”_ \- Mark McManus, General President, United Association of Union Plumbers and Pipefitters (UA)
---
This is the kind of progress New Mexicans and Americans deserve: lower energy costs, more good-paying jobs, responsible growth, and a clean-energy future we can be proud to pass on to our kids.
_The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act_ delivers for families by lowering energy costs, creating good-paying jobs, and protecting New Mexico families and small businesses from being stuck with the costs of massive New data centers.
It helps connect clean energy to the grid faster, which means new job opportunities in clean energy, manufacturing, and infrastructure across New Mexico.
And it does all of this while keeping key environmental and consultation safeguards in place, protecting the public’s ability to challenge projects, and securing dedicated funding to clean up abandoned hardrock mines so **we can deliver for families and protect our public lands at the same time.**
**[I’m proud of the bipartisan work we’ve done to earn support for the _Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act_. We’re proud to endorse it, and we’re excited to mobilize our grassroots volunteers in full support.” \- Rick Bradley, Citizens Climate Lobby’s Executive Director “...will increase project certainty, streamline federal review timelines, and create thousands of good-paying jobs – all while maintaining reasonable environmental safeguards and opportunities for public input.” \- Mark McManus, General President, United Association of Union Plumbers and Pipefitters (UA) This is the kind of progress New Mexicans and Americans deserve: lower energy costs, more good-paying jobs, responsible growth, and a clean-energy future we can be proud to pass on to our kids. The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act delivers for families by lowering energy costs, creating good-paying jobs, and protecting New Mexico families and small businesses from being stuck with the costs of massive New data centers. It helps connect clean energy to the grid faster, which means new job opportunities in clean energy, manufacturing, and infrastructure across New Mexico. And it does all of this while keeping key environmental and consultation safeguards in place, protecting the public’s ability to challenge projects, and securing dedicated funding to clean up abandoned hardrock mines so we can deliver for families and protect our public lands at the same time. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = Thanks for being a partner. Let’s get this done. Yesterday, I challenged Greg Abbott to meet me in front of the Governor's mansion for a debate, and to no one's surprise -- he didn't show.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/60f6de97-5223-4db5-9b7a-5f0f06ae8f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
During this campaign, I've accepted four separate invitations to debate, while Abbott has ignored _all_ of them.
Texans deserve to hear a plan for Texas where we secure the American Dream by saving our public schools and putting money in your pocket. They also deserve to hear Greg Abbott defend his twelve year record in office.
But Abbott continues to stay silent and dodge accountability. He's taking cover because he knows he has failed Texans while enriching himself.
Abbott's decade-long record speaks for itself: Texans have faced years of rising costs (including property taxes), some of the highest uninsured rates in the country, families struggling to keep the lights on because electricity has become so expensive, and billions of our taxpayer dollars flowing to politically connected donors and special interests instead of working people.
**Greg Abbott has sold the people of Texas to the highest bidder, and I 'm running to change that.**
Texans deserve a governor that they can trust to put their needs first. And come November, I'll be ready to deliver.
Growing up in the Valley taught me the importance of hard work and keeping your word. My promise for Texas is that our kids will be able to go to a good neighborhood school. That Texans will be able to buy a home and not be priced out by property taxes or high electricity bills. And that the rich and powerful won't get to dictate how the rest of us live.
Texans deserve a governor who isn't afraid of a tough battle and is always willing to do what's right. That's our fight this election, and I hope I can count on you to keep fighting with me.
**[Greg Abbott can keep avoiding the conversation because there really is nothing left to say. If you believe Texans deserve a governor who will put them and their families first, will you please support me in my race for governor with a $5 or more donation today? We're 18 days away from Election Day and every dollar you give goes directly to connecting with the thousands of undecided voters who will make or break whether or not we win.](https://substack.com/redirect/60f6de97-5223-4db5-9b7a-5f0f06ae8f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[DONATE ->](https://substack.com/redirect/60f6de97-5223-4db5-9b7a-5f0f06ae8f84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'll never stop showing up for the people of Texas.
-- Gina

Oct 16 | | | | | | | | | | | Yesterday, I challenged Greg Abbott to meet me in front of the Governor's mansion for a debate, and to no one's surprise -- he didn't show. | | ---|---|--- During this campaign, I've accepted four separate invitations to debate, while Abbott has ignored all of them. Texans deserve to hear a plan for Texas where we secure the American Dream by saving our public schools and putting money in your pocket. They also deserve to hear Greg Abbott defend his twelve year record in office. But Abbott continues to stay silent and dodge accountability. He's taking cover because he knows he has failed Texans while enriching himself. Abbott's decade-long record speaks for itself: Texans have faced years of rising costs (including property taxes), some of the highest uninsured rates in the country, families struggling to keep the lights on because electricity has become so expensive, and billions of our taxpayer dollars flowing to politically connected donors and special interests instead of working people. Greg Abbott has sold the people of Texas to the highest bidder, and I 'm running to change that. Texans deserve a governor that they can trust to put their needs first. And come November, I'll be ready to deliver. Growing up in the Valley taught me the importance of hard work and keeping your word. My promise for Texas is that our kids will be able to go to a good neighborhood school. That Texans will be able to buy a home and not be priced out by property taxes or high electricity bills. And that the rich and powerful won't get to dictate how the rest of us live. Texans deserve a governor who isn't afraid of a tough battle and is always willing to do what's right. That's our fight this election, and I hope I can count on you to keep fighting with me. I'll never stop showing up for the people of Texas. -- Gina | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Gina Hinojosa PO Box 300095, Austin, TX 78703 ? ?

I want to direct some of this energy towards an incredibly important race here in Minnesota
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2531%2E791427%2EP9CSR8)
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-ellison.eG7HJ0&refcode=em261016-1-210&t=2&akid=2531%2E791427%2EP9CSR8)
Friend, with everything that’s happened this week as Trump weaponizes the full force of federal law enforcement against me, we’ve seen a huge outpouring of support from across the country and a swell of momentum behind our efforts.
**I want to direct some of that energy towards an incredibly important race here in Minnesota, and really make this moment count.**
My friend Keith Ellison has been an effective and diligent Attorney General for Minnesota, always fighting for the interests of the people and seeking justice for all. He’s running for reelection at a time when Trump and all of MAGA have targeted Minnesota and our communities with lies, conspiracies, and ICE violence.
Keith’s in a close race, and it’s imperative that we give him any help we can in the final days before this election. Every dollar we can help raise will go directly into his team’s efforts to fight MAGA’s false narratives, share Keith’s vision for Minnesota, and turn out the progressive voters we need to win.
And the great thing is, by supporting Keith and me today, you’re also giving a big boost to progressives up and down the ballot here in Minnesota who will benefit from our GOTV efforts. We have a big team organizing on the ground, and they could really use the help.
So please: [**Can you split a donation today between Keith Ellison and my campaign? If you stand with me as I take on Trump, I’m asking you to stand with Keith too, as he fights for the people of my district, my city, and my beautiful state of Minnesota.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-ellison.eG7HJ0&refcode=em261016-1-210&t=3&akid=2531%2E791427%2EP9CSR8)

name: Shawnna Bolick
subject: Arizona Needs More Than Your Vote. We Need Your Help.

body:
Running for office isn't for the faint of heart. Why do I continue to stand in the gap and fight for our state's prosperity?

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/JQkY_KP5ij7?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)
| | | | | | **Why I Returned to the State Capitol** Running for office isn't for the faint of heart. Why do I continue to stand in the gap and fight for our state's prosperity?As many of you know, when Steve Kaiser, my predecessor, resigned in June 2023 because of the current political climate, returning to the State Capitol certainly wasn't on my bingo card. I was recruited back.After my campaign in 2022, I donated of all my campaign materials by giving away rebar, H-posts, zip ties, post pounders, and other campaign supplies. It felt liberating to reclaim part of our garage and move on from campaigning.But I accepted the call and returned to the State Capitol because I believe we **must** protect Arizona from policies that threaten:
* Educational choice and broad learning opportunities
* Our state's right-to-work status
* A flat-tax, low-regulation environment
* Second Amendment rights
* Our public safety safety
* The principles that Reagan conservatives and freedom-loving Americans hold dear.

Every election cycle reminds me how different Arizona could look if I hadn't stepped forward to help maintain a Republican majority in the State Senate. I was recruited to return because of my four years of service in the House, my record as a commonsense conservative voice, and the relationships I built throughout our legislative district.

## What's at Stake This November
As Election Day approaches, radical Democrats and out-of-state special interest labor groups are flooding Arizona's competitive swing districts with **millions of dollars in outside dark money** , hoping to buy competitive legislative seats through misleading attacks and falsehoods.In our district alone, they have spent hundreds of thousands of dollars in the past three weeks on deceptive mailers, street signs, digital advertisements, text messages, and other campaign tactics designed to mislead voters.Their goal is simple: flip this seat and move one step closer to dismantling policies that have preserved Arizona's economic competitiveness, educational freedom, and constitutional rights.The radical left understands what's at stake.If they succeed in defeating me, they will be one step closer to weakening Arizona's popular Empowerment Scholarship Account (ESA) program, undermining our right-to-work protections, raising taxes, expanding government regulations, and restricting constitutional rights, including the Second Amendment freedoms Arizonans cherish.
Benjamin Franklin said it best:_"Those who would give up essential Liberty, to purchase a little temporary Safety, deserve neither Liberty nor Safety."_
Our liberty, opportunity, constitutional rights, and freedoms are on the ballot this November.If this highly competitive State Senate seat flips, along with one additional legislative district, the future direction of our state could change dramatically over the course of a few weeks if the Democrats take control of both chambers and hold the executive office.

## How You Can Help Us Win
These final weeks will determine the outcome of this election, and nothing is more important than turning out our voters.If you believe in educational freedom, low taxes, constitutional rights, and keeping Arizona on the path of opportunity, [I need you on our team](https://us.list-manage.com/1AbzR31nSBl?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211). A few hours of your time can make all the difference in a race that could help determine the future direction of our state.Whether you can knock doors, make phone calls, send text messages, talk to neighbors, host a neighborhood gathering, or simply encourage friends and family to vote, [there is a place for you in this effort](mailto:info@bolickforarizona.com?subject=I%20would%20like%20to%20volunteer&body=). We can provide targeted voter lists, training, and the tools you need to be effective.Don't assume someone else will do the work. The people trying to flip this seat are counting on conservatives to stay home and sit on the sidelines.**We cannot let that happen.** If you've ever thought about [getting involved](https://us.list-manage.com/I61nX0pztd_?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211), now is the time. The future direction of Arizona will be shaped by those who show up and engage.Don't let out-of-state dark money groups buy influence in our state while claiming to defend values they actively work to weaken.Together, we can protect the freedoms, opportunities, and principles that have made Arizona a beacon of liberty and prosperity. As a proud Arizonan in Goldwater country, I know our best days are still ahead, but only if we are willing to stand up, get involved, and fight for them.

## Can't Volunteer? Help Us Fight Back.
If you are unable to volunteer, I respectfully ask you to consider making a [contribution](https://us.list-manage.com/VuslWmUgqDM?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211) today.The reality is that our opponents are being fueled by millions of dollars from out-of-state special interest groups and labor organizations determined to flip Arizona's most competitive legislative districts. Every day, they are spending heavily on mail, digital advertising, text messaging, and voter outreach designed to drown out our message and mislead voters.We cannot match them dollar for dollar, but with your help, we can continue reaching voters with the truth.**Your**[**contribution**](https://us.list-manage.com/K9bAK0bVJM6?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)**today will help us:**
* Reach more voters through direct mail and digital advertising
* Expand our voter-contact and get-out-the-vote efforts
* Counter misleading attacks with facts
* Turn out the conservative voters who will decide this election

Whether it's $25, $50, $100, or more, every dollar helps us compete during these critical final weeks.**This race may ultimately be decided by a small number of votes.** That's why every conversation, every door knocked, every mail piece delivered, and every donation matters.Please don't wait until tomorrow. **Make your**[**contribution**](https://us.list-manage.com/abvQsUEtF73?e=a7ab36849c&c2id=b6e4918ecaa4a9e494d38fc9e6fde211)**today and help us finish this race strong.** The other side is counting on conservatives to stay on the sidelines. Let's prove them wrong.

## We May Be Outspent, But We Will Not Be Outworked
Together, we will win this race, protect our majority, defend the freedoms we cherish, and keep Arizona moving forward.Thank you for continuing to stand with us and for all you do for Arizona.Sincerely,Shawnna

name: Kristan Hawkins
subject: They're getting doors slammed in their faces
body:
Two weeks until Election Day. Our student canvassers need to know you have their backs.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* | | |
---
| | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0M2q2zAQxfGnkXcxnpEjxwsvCiG7222XZiyNHXH1hTS-pW9fEtoXuOs_HH6cXx_rB_ng0_GTIi9V9rW2VZ78p_LBIj4dLufaWqAY2a04oLnAcAGzkhX_xetInVucdQS24wWmGcHcNGD3XMBObiPGDchs021nwut1vsI23nYNM3Z-ee3BAAaMhnHutdFXJMRJA0ybAzUOFLhKX7mcW_CWklD73HO13Nscu7A8RUpT-ofCh8JHY3tW7pucjpO0Pdfgd35Rc-pzPRQ-Cl0sVS5kP-lgNEo_WrVK3zmWqtDEdnin9P0NmwspNKfE1VIs5I_0Kv_Q_0tOwkmUvlfZu7q48tuH4JuZ1DgckXx4U-Wb734t-DcAAP__cW2K6Q)

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Our volunteer student canvassers have been through the wringer these past couple of months.

Doors get slammed in their faces. They get shouted off stoops. And sometimes, even worse things happen.

So, I’ve told every one of our canvassers to prepare for anything over the next two weeks.

Pro-Life Friend, our student canvassers know what’s on the line.

They know if abortion-loving leftists seize power in November, it will be a death sentence to millions more innocent preborn babies.

And they know the job’s not done yet.

But right now, they could use a little moral boost heading into the final weeks before Election Day on Tuesday, November 3rd.

[That’s why I’m hoping you’ll prayerfully consider sending a Care Package to one of our door-to-door canvassers](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0M2q2zAQxfGnkXcxnpEjxwsvCiG7222XZiyNHXH1hTS-pW9fEtoXuOs_HH6cXx_rB_ng0_GTIi9V9rW2VZ78p_LBIj4dLufaWqAY2a04oLnAcAGzkhX_xetInVucdQS24wWmGcHcNGD3XMBObiPGDchs021nwut1vsI23nYNM3Z-ee3BAAaMhnHutdFXJMRJA0ybAzUOFLhKX7mcW_CWklD73HO13Nscu7A8RUpT-ofCh8JHY3tW7pucjpO0Pdfgd35Rc-pzPRQ-Cl0sVS5kP-lgNEo_WrVK3zmWqtDEdnin9P0NmwspNKfE1VIs5I_0Kv_Q_0tOwkmUvlfZu7q48tuH4JuZ1DgckXx4U-Wb734t-DcAAP__cW2K6Q)**.**

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I’m the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

These young women and men will be on their feet for hours, walking door to door. And knowing pro-lifers like you have their backs will help keep them going.

Of course, I could tell our door knockers to go home.

I could focus on running expensive TV ads instead.

But studies show that face-to-face conversations move voters more than any TV ad ever could. And the effect doesn’t disappear after one election.

**Voters who talk to one of our students in person are more likely to show up and vote again in the next election, too.**

And, it costs us less than $3 for every door we knock.

This is the on-the-ground grassroots campaigning that’s needed to turn out every pro-life voter.

Last cycle, this approach worked.
**> >> In Oklahoma,** our canvassers knocked 633 doors, made 26,931 phone calls, and sent 26,078 texts exposing two pro-abortion state senators who killed our legislation to stop chemical abortion pill trafficking. Voters threw them out.

**> >> In South Carolina,** we knocked 2,572 doors and made 51,371 calls exposing three pro-abortion Republican senators who killed our “Life at Conception Act.” They lost too.

**> >> In North Carolina,** 1,052 doors and 52,554 texts helped four pro-life candidates win their primaries.
The Abortion Lobby would love nothing more than for our students to give up and go home during this final stretch.

It’s true they have the money, the media, and the institutions.

But what they don’t have is thousands of young pro-lifers willing to knock on a stranger’s door, get yelled at, sometimes get hit with worse than words, and still go knock on the next door.

That grit and determination is what wins elections.

[So, will you please make your most generous contribution today to keep our canvassers in the field through the two most important weeks of this election season](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0M2q2zAQxfGnkXcxnpEjxwsvCiG7222XZiyNHXH1hTS-pW9fEtoXuOs_HH6cXx_rB_ng0_GTIi9V9rW2VZ78p_LBIj4dLufaWqAY2a04oLnAcAGzkhX_xetInVucdQS24wWmGcHcNGD3XMBObiPGDchs021nwut1vsI23nYNM3Z-ee3BAAaMhnHutdFXJMRJA0ybAzUOFLhKX7mcW_CWklD73HO13Nscu7A8RUpT-ofCh8JHY3tW7pucjpO0Pdfgd35Rc-pzPRQ-Cl0sVS5kP-lgNEo_WrVK3zmWqtDEdnin9P0NmwspNKfE1VIs5I_0Kv_Q_0tOwkmUvlfZu7q48tuH4JuZ1DgckXx4U-Wb734t-DcAAP__cW2K6Q)**?**
**> >> $250** fully funds a canvasser’s entire day in the field: more than 80 doors knocked, one voter conversation at a time.

**> >> $100** puts a canvasser on more than 30 doors in a key race.

**> >> $50** covers a tank of gas for a canvasser’s day of driving to and from strategic locations.

**> >> $25** pays for a canvasser’s meals for a day in the field.

**> >> $10** puts our pro-life message on more than three doors.
Pro-Life Friend, door knocking has been our key to beating both the Abortion Lobby and the D.C. consultant class for years.

You see, they like wasting their donors’ money on flashy, expensive cable TV ads because it lines their pockets.

Meanwhile, real people having real conversations are what actually move voters in November. That’s how we helped 119 pro-life legislators WIN in 2024!

So, please let our dedicated student activists know you care about them and appreciate the hard work they’re doing for the entire pro-life movement.

[Will you please send a Care Package to one of our canvassers right now](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0M2q2zAQxfGnkXcxnpEjxwsvCiG7222XZiyNHXH1hTS-pW9fEtoXuOs_HH6cXx_rB_ng0_GTIi9V9rW2VZ78p_LBIj4dLufaWqAY2a04oLnAcAGzkhX_xetInVucdQS24wWmGcHcNGD3XMBObiPGDchs021nwut1vsI23nYNM3Z-ee3BAAaMhnHutdFXJMRJA0ybAzUOFLhKX7mcW_CWklD73HO13Nscu7A8RUpT-ofCh8JHY3tW7pucjpO0Pdfgd35Rc-pzPRQ-Cl0sVS5kP-lgNEo_WrVK3zmWqtDEdnin9P0NmwspNKfE1VIs5I_0Kv_Q_0tOwkmUvlfZu7q48tuH4JuZ1DgckXx4U-Wb734t-DcAAP__cW2K6Q)**?**

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, Students for Life Action

P.S. – Election Day is Tuesday, November 3rd, and our canvassers will be knocking on doors right up to the finish line. [Please help keep them in the field with a Care Package Gift of $25 or more today](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0M2q2zAQxfGnkXcxnpEjxwsvCiG7222XZiyNHXH1hTS-pW9fEtoXuOs_HH6cXx_rB_ng0_GTIi9V9rW2VZ78p_LBIj4dLufaWqAY2a04oLnAcAGzkhX_xetInVucdQS24wWmGcHcNGD3XMBObiPGDchs021nwut1vsI23nYNM3Z-ee3BAAaMhnHutdFXJMRJA0ybAzUOFLhKX7mcW_CWklD73HO13Nscu7A8RUpT-ofCh8JHY3tW7pucjpO0Pdfgd35Rc-pzPRQ-Cl0sVS5kP-lgNEo_WrVK3zmWqtDEdnin9P0NmwspNKfE1VIs5I_0Kv_Q_0tOwkmUvlfZu7q48tuH4JuZ1DgckXx4U-Wb734t-DcAAP__cW2K6Q)**.** _Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action’s mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization._

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Our $1 million donation to Abdul El-Sayed
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
I wanted to send a short message letting you know I've decided to contribute $1 million to Abdul El-Sayed's campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan.
The Michigan Senate race is neck and neck. This election will come down to the wire and the result will be consequential for our entire country. Every vote, call, door, and dollar between now and November 3rd will affect the outcome of this race. And I don’t want to wake up on November 4th wishing I did more to combat the smears aimed at Abdul.
It's important for you to know that this isn't $1 million I have sitting around in a personal bank account. This money comes from small pieces of the more than 2 million individual donations made by people across the country this election cycle.
It is not MY contribution. It is OUR contribution.
Same goes for the money we've spent traveling to and holding rallies across the country for other progressives. And the money we've spent to hire organizers in Memphis and Florida to help Justin J. Pearson and Angie Nixon win their races.
So if you are interested in continuing to support that work, I am asking:
[ Can you please make a contribution to my campaign today? Our average donation is around $16. Some give more. Some give less. The amount of the donation isn't nearly as important as the number of people chipping in to support our work. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261016-12456-P_FND_EXP_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12456%2E2526796%2E80kmHy)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-26-q4.h3BeQC&refcode=em20261016-12456-P_FND_EXP_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=12456%2E2526796%2E80kmHy)**
Thank you for your continued support.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

Congress. A new report from The Washington Post just revealed that the
first Trump administration tried to find issues with Ilhan’s citizenship
back in 2019 and came up empty.

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: A GOP midterm warning and a TV forum meltdown
body:
Plus: The new White House press secretary’s rough first day | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/oftTvzJVR9D?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
Speaker Mike Johnson says the polls are wrong. Realistically, the House is probably gone, and the real fight in the midterms is for the Senate. Kansas is tied, and Iowa, Maine and Alaska are within a couple of points. We go through every close race and explain what it will take for Republicans to hold the Senate.

Also, you have to see this: a Democrat running for county council in Indiana went on local TV and said her plan if elected was to fire all Republicans. That was not even close to the strangest thing she said.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/U1yquNHd04_?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| |
**🏛️ GOP WARNING: THE REAL FIGHT IS FOR THE SENATE**
Speaker Johnson went on Fox News and said the polls are missing Republican voters, and he has a point. CNN’s Harry Enten found the early October generic ballot has underestimated Republicans in 14 of the last 16 elections.
But polls don’t vote. These are turnout elections now, and right now Democrats are more fired up to show up. If Republicans want to hold the Senate, their voters have to match that.
Scott Jennings also asks the question Democrats haven’t answered this year: what would they actually do differently?
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/VIGWmqy8pey?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**📺 AN INDIANA DEMOCRAT’S PLAN: “FIRING ALL REPUBLICANS”**
Jaime West is running for county council in Fayette County, Indiana. A local station asked her what unpopular decision she would make for the good of the county. She asked to hear the question again, then said she would fire all Republicans.
Then she told viewers who she says threatened her. Her last words to voters are why the clip went viral.

**🗳️ LUJÁN LEADS MARKER BY DOUBLE DIGITS, AND CD2 IS A COIN FLIP**
The new Albuquerque Journal poll has Sen. Ben Ray Luján well ahead of Larry Marker. We talk about why New Mexico’s senators keep siding with their party over their state, and the border is the clearest example.
In CD2, Gabe Vasquez leads Greg Cunningham 48 to 44. That’s inside the margin of error, and we break down what it will take for Cunningham to close the gap.

**🎤 THE NEW PRESS SECRETARY’S FIRST BRIEFING**
Katie Zacharia’s first White House briefing did not go well. We remember our first TV live shots, and we explain what she needs to do before the next one.
Ava is home for fall break, and she disagrees with both of us! She doesn’t think someone speaking for the president gets time to grow into the job, and she makes a strong case.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/6CYkX6ei7En?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| |
**PLUS:** Kacey Musgraves brought James Talarico to her concert, and James Hetfield told a Metallica crowd why his band stays out of politics. A viewer wrote in to defend the Bigfoot film. And it’s our anniversary, so we dug up an old VHS clip from KJCT in Grand Junction, back when we competed for every story.

[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/110148?refcode=em20261016-11022&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11022%2E614464%2EQE4CR9)
Peter:
We're just under one month out from Election Day, and the pressure is on. But not for the reasons you might think...
The truth is: I don’t want to let you down.
You are the heart of this campaign. Since the very beginning, grassroots donors have made it possible to compete with massive spending from special interests. You’ve proven that when working people come together, we can win:
* When Peter Thiel dropped $3.6 million against me in a single week, you helped keep our own ads live.
* When JD Vance personally attacked me, you stood by me and helped this campaign surge ahead.
* And when crypto billionaires decided to put $30 million behind new attack ads spreading lies about me, you helped us fight back.

But this race is far from over, Peter.
All eyes are on Ohio, and the money continues to pour in. In fact, Republican megadonors are spending more here than in Georgia, Alaska, and North Carolina combined. Let that sink in.
I’m not sharing this to scare you – the polls keep proving that we have what it takes to win – but I’m writing this to remind you just how important you are to this movement.
**In the face of a quarter of a BILLION dollars being spent by Republicans in Ohio, our campaign has been able to stay competitive only because of grassroots donations from folks like you. And right now, I need you to have my back more than ever.**
My past races have taught me that this close to Election Day, resources are what allow a candidate to pull ahead. So we cannot give the GOP an inch.
**[Today, I’m asking you to split $10 between my campaign and Heartland Patriots. I’m counting on you. Will you give what you can to help us flip Ohio and take back the Senate?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/110148?refcode=em20261016-11022&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=11022%2E614464%2EQE4CR9)**

## **From the 30th White House Press Secretary to the 37th: My Advice for Katie Zacharia**
In case you forgot - and take my word for it, there's no need to search the archives - I had a tough first outing behind the podium as White House Press Secretary.
So when the new White House Press Secretary, Katie Zacharia, stepped up for her first briefing this week, I immediately recognized the immense pressure of that room. Like my own debut, her first outing didn't go exactly as it was drawn up on the whiteboard. While I had originally planned to brief on the first full workday following a long three-day holiday weekend, the President had other plans.

Katie's first day on the job was a federal holiday. I wonder if she even had time to get issued a badge and computer, let alone process the mountain of onboarding paperwork. Then, just hours later, she was sent out to address an unfamiliar, hungry press corps expecting her to speak authoritatively on every issue from domestic economic strategy to complex foreign policy.
Having stood at that podium, taken the heat, and managed the daily pressure cooker of the White House briefing room, here are 5 crucial lessons for surviving - and thriving - in one of the toughest jobs in politics.

But first, I know how much you care about helping Democrats flip the House on November 3rd, and so many of you have been jumping into the fray and offering support where you can. So thank you, truly, for all the ways you’ve shown up. As co-chair of the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee’s Red Alert program, I’m proud to highlight the races across the country that are facing tough moments and help rally support so they have the resources they need to win. = DCCC Red Alert Round #3 Frontline Members: Rep. Marcy Kaptur (OH-09) Red to Blue Candidates: Chris Jones (AR-02) Amish Shah (AZ-01) Manny Rutinel (CO-08) Pia Dandiya (FL-22) Cait Conley (NY-17) Bob Harvie (PA-01) Mitchell Berman (WI-01) Republican super PACs are spending millions to defeat my colleagues Susie Lee (NV-03), Tom Suozzi (NY-03), and Marcy Kaptur (OH-09) , so these strong Dems will need the resources to keep fighting back and talking with voters in these final weeks. Chris Jones (AR-02) is a 7th-generation Arkansan raised by minister parents who just got added to the DCCC Red to Blue list after putting this red seat on the map. Manny Rutinel (CO-08) is the son of a single mom who immigrated from Latin America and is running in one of the most competitive House districts in the country. Dr. Amish Shah is an ER physician who came within 4 points of flipping AZ-01 in 2024, and now this open seat is one of Democrats’ top pick-up opportunities this cycle. Pia Dandiya (FL-22) is a working mom and educator taking on a self-funded MAGA opponent who backed Trump’s Big Ugly Bill. Mitchell Berman (WI-01) is an ER nurse who’s seen firsthand what Republicans’ healthcare cuts have done to real people, and is running to stand up to corruption and special interests in Washington. Cait Conley (NY-17) and Bob Harvie (PA-01) are both running for seats that Kamala Harris won last cycle – and both races are very much in play. We're showing up to debate— _with or without Marsha Blackburn._** _**We've already done three.**_ Now, we are doing one more tonight in Knoxville, followed by another upcoming forum at _MTSU on October 27th_ with Independent candidates _who are polling at less than 2%_ These are open, unscripted forums to talk about real solutions for Tennessee— _from lowering costs and protecting our schools to wiping out medical debt_ —and to answer your questions directly. _**Anyone, no matter your background or who you voted for, is welcome to join us.**_ _****__**Tonight's Knoxville Debate Details:**_
* **When: _TONIGHT, Friday, October 16th at 6:30 PM Eastern Time_**
* **Where:** University of Tennessee, Humanities and Social Sciences Building, HSS Room 123

That’s also why we announced four different opportunities for Marsha Blackburn to show up, defend her record, and debate the issues that matter most to Tennesseans. She’s hiding from voters, refusing to debate, and running a campaign that shows she simply doesn't care what Tennesseans want. Well, we aren't letting her off the hook that easily. We're showing up to debate— with or without Marsha Blackburn. We've already done three. Now, we are doing one more tonight in Knoxville, followed by another upcoming forum at MTSU on October 27th with Independent candidates who are polling at less than 2% These are open, unscripted forums to talk about real solutions for Tennessee— from lowering costs and protecting our schools to wiping out medical debt —and to answer your questions directly. | | | I made history as the first Muslim woman elected statewide in the nation. That milestone belongs to everyone who believes our democracy should make room for every voice. But a voice only matters if people have the right to use it. And at a moment when voting rights are under sustained attack, we have a chance to protect that right here in Virginia. Question 3 would enshrine the fundamental right to vote in our Constitution for all eligible Virginians and ensure that those who have completed their sentences and returned to our communities can participate in our democracy. No one’s right to vote should depend on who holds the governor’s office. In my community college classrooms, I taught many returning citizens. I believe in second chances, and I’ve always believed our communities are stronger when people have a say in the decisions shaping their lives. This November, let’s make that promise real for every Virginian. **[Will you chip in $15 today to help pass Question 3?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141563114/653976736/-725132633?refcode=261016em&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDk1NGFiOS04M2M5LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4ksL1Nkj5eCRAE2DZ5KWTqIvhJkqTDcjUIJSAgfl6gI=)**

clean_body: No one’s right to vote should depend on who holds the governor’s office.| | | | = | | | I made history as the first Muslim woman elected statewide in the nation. That milestone belongs to everyone who believes our democracy should make room for every voice. But a voice only matters if people have the right to use it. And at a moment when voting rights are under sustained attack, we have a chance to protect that right here in Virginia. Question 3 would enshrine the fundamental right to vote in our Constitution for all eligible Virginians and ensure that those who have completed their sentences and returned to our communities can participate in our democracy. No one’s right to vote should depend on who holds the governor’s office. In my community college classrooms, I taught many returning citizens. I believe in second chances, and I’ve always believed our communities are stronger when people have a say in the decisions shaping their lives. This November, let’s make that promise real for every Virginian. = | | | = Your contribution will help the Virginians for the Right to Vote campaign reach voters and build support across the Commonwealth. We’re close to making lasting progress, but we need you with us to get it done. Let’s protect every Virginian’s voice. | | **Spartz Campaign Reports More Sign Theft, Trespassing, and Lawlessness**
---
| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**October 15, 2026** **WESTFIELD, IN** - The **Spartz** campaign is reporting another wave of stolen **Victoria Spartz** campaign signs and unauthorized placement of anti-**Spartz** and **J.D. Ford** campaign signs. Large **Spartz** campaign signs have been stolen again. Hostile signs featuring the Congresswoman’s name crossed out, along with **J.D. Ford** campaign signs, have been placed in public rights-of-way and on private properties without owners’ permission. These incidents have been reported to law enforcement and local government officials. “I’ve been through a lot of campaigns, but I’ve never seen supporters as obnoxious and disrespectful of the law as **J.D. Ford** ’s. It’s no surprise, given **Ford** ’s record of voting to defund the police and backing rioters who looted businesses in Indianapolis, which he just moved from to run for this office,” said Congresswoman **Victoria Spartz**. “Theft, criminal trespass, intimidation, and lawlessness have no place in our communities.” Anyone with information about these incidents is encouraged to contact the **Spartz** campaign at [info@spartzforcongress.com](mailto:info@spartzforcongress.com).

Derek, This year, investigators in my office uncovered the contracts behind the banners of Donald Trump’s face now hanging on federal buildings across Washington — the largest of them eight stories tall at the Department of Health and Human Services, with “America First” printed beside it: [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?amount=10&t=8&refcode=aschiff_email_101626_banners&akid=10815%2E5257348%2En74aoK) | | [DONATE TO FIGHT BACK→](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/8046?amount=10&t=9&refcode=aschiff_email_101626_banners&akid=10815%2E5257348%2En74aoK)
---
Here’s what we uncovered:
The American people paid for every inch of these banners, and we have the receipts. $114,000 from the FAA. $39,000 from Interior. A third check from the Labor Department.
The list goes on and on.
**Congress long ago outlawed spending taxpayer dollars on propaganda and self-aggrandizement, and an eight-story-high Donald Trump head certainly qualifies.**
I spent years as a federal prosecutor and worked overseas for the Justice Department, and I’ve seen this corrupt movie before. In every country where democracy gave way to one man, the faces went up on the government buildings first.
They didn’t go up as decoration, or even as vanity, but to teach the people who paid for those buildings a simple lesson: _all of this belongs to him now._
And yet not one of those buildings belongs to Donald Trump.
They belong to the American people, to the taxpayers who funded them. We were never asked, and we do not have to accept it. Any more than the taxpayer-funded campaign commercials he has been airing.
**We have just weeks left to win a check on this president that he cannot fire and cannot intimidate: a Democratic Senate majority, with the gavels and subpoena power to hold him to account.**

body:
News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong.

---
| Letter from the Chair
---
| Friends,
Let's be blunt. The Democrats can't win Nebraska off their platform. So they're betting you won't show up.
That's the whole plan. Out-of-state money for Denise Powell in Omaha. A Democrat Party backing Dan Osborn instead of running its own nominee. Paid organizers knocking doors in your neighborhood right now. All of it built on one assumption: that Nebraska Republicans are too comfortable to vote.
And if they're right, we pay for it. Lose the Senate seat, and Chuck Schumer is one step closer to running the U.S. Senate again. Lose two seats in the Legislature, and property tax relief dies in a filibuster. Lose the State Board of Education, and the people deciding what your kids learn won't share your values. Lose the races at the bottom of the ballot, and your utility bill gets set by people who never answer to you.
Remember, 312 votes gave Washington Obamacare. Don't let a few hundred Nebraskans who "meant to vote" hand our state to the Left.
So let's make a plan, and let's make it today.
Start by making sure you're registered at ne.gov/go/votercheck. It takes thirty seconds. If you've moved, you still have until October 23 to register in person at your county election office.
Then decide when you're voting, and don't say "Election Day." In-person early voting is open right now at your county election office through November 2. Walk in, vote, and be done with it. If you'd rather vote by mail, get your request in by October 23 and drop that ballot off yourself instead of trusting it to the mail at the last minute.
Bring your photo ID. We fought hard for voter ID in this state. Use it.
And when you get your ballot, vote the whole thing, top to bottom. The Left shows up for every race on that ballot, from Senate to the power board. So should we.
Last thing. Don't go alone. Bring your spouse, your neighbor, and that coworker who complains about property taxes every Monday but hasn't voted since 2020. Don't just remind them. Bring them.
The other side has a plan. Now you do too.
Together we win!
In Liberty and in Truth,
Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

Despite serving in the minority during my first term, I brought $14 million back to the cities I represent. That’s our tax dollars being reinvested here at home, _and I fought tooth and claw for every dollar._ But there’s a lot more I need to do. When the GKN plant emergency forced evacuations across our community, I pushed to get our first responders the resources they needed. clean_body: | = I was asked point-blank, friend: why should anyone send you back to Washington? My work’s not done. Despite serving in the minority during my first term, I brought $14 million back to the cities I represent. That’s our tax dollars being reinvested here at home, and I fought tooth and claw for every dollar. But there’s a lot more I need to do. When the GKN plant emergency forced evacuations across our community, I pushed to get our first responders the resources they needed. Families and small businesses who were forced out still haven’t been made whole, and I’m going to keep pressing GKN until they are. = | = My opponent, Chuong Vo, is running on his law enforcement background. What he conveniently doesn’t mention is that law enforcement is backing me, including the LA and Orange County sheriffs’ unions and even the California Fraternal Order of Police. body:
We are less than a month from the most important midterm elections of our lifetimes. I need you with me. | Fellow American,

I want to be honest with you about where we are.

We are less than a month from the midterms. And every morning I walk into the Senate, I think about what happens to the work we have done....._the border gains, the judicial nominees, the parental rights wins, if we lose this majority._

It does not get preserved. It gets dismantled.

I did not run for this seat to watch everything we built get handed back to the people who spent years tearing it down. I ran because I believe that the America my kids inherit depends on what conservatives do right now, in these final weeks, before November closes the door on this moment.

**_[Fellow American, I need to know you are with me for the stretch run.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=22dbf59548de48caa3f38245dda83db7&_e=BXQms6THreYuSHWmiboz_4xzX-T6CXHljlgWdHR4TngvL0K-MH8tACttf6ZHjwj1JQnmVY7AhS39FyHZ5ponHu298xcRoX_3xOZqROZ6Xr-WKrXj-jA2aJvASR5hZiI07xVG6KtrXocAd_tRBSEuWQo4LqaqJppSMqDLJLGbIBhY5I_uWTRr_4q4ptEWZbcJZ0ojdX88f4QOr6pfeLY3STNh7YsZ5ozCKcngCH6Wh7lckXnz2xm3mQ6rzDC08-f1E5frkZ3KlecgDKimXET6KAFsWKRtx0rTM_-pi5RT8w2ELeYRmK4mpckAxpR9pAo7h3cbryVq-Sjosoa2G5jyotm5uRuSeCNlSUh5F0DUOuw-HM1hEbEEOo83NDvhQhRkua3MXugkKPbXwhVBP_z05A_IposrYeUBsQnBysH-KqVISUA7LoPn1P6dB5dGcct7NoqdvkTd3Pflk0Ri6hktrGnEIP9CmlTn_gattw3FTz2G_cdXXyxFkp__fOIxXsH1YjULmVyS5QiX7QDnFw-BYvPNzDgWSalpocpPMzazq7NTTEzWfBvdg7yyM-FqCxX2LRGndlqDOUXj1NXYBcsfQRNReddJqjVfzArFLPEtY08ePkuBoKsFRQGnM7VqrGsTFs5GpEXG69PCnWXROVEE4OCQ9gIAPrJMHE4JAhmm_ZlNu4ELJfIFgkhCOdvvd9VDvZezo8G4866yrSIgqvaRI58Q3zTPhBEZIeI41liqW-Q5T5CRq_va9snf9aC16pIQQwhHVZPICPXs9kbecoSrVCYygiVnYFPLACTM7GP9sOgwzl8LqXmUf82eWyUPMSgYJp4_Cd6mCMm_A8UHW8x3adzkcYgM4MZJ1OzOX8tKflKg49YtPfSl-Qel8YxJJ14lpOX4SwjpMxD3Q5pSr3ddhatBS2DarhVy4HzNfAmiY2GrFpDqDPnmggqx6_uj1DJhLy3YWZsfzo76ommS6-eDWkhlyp73sgPCrYyi_eACUpAiZ74P0oBwA82-MuRji73jduC2q8vkYP-iUxF_cagmcYn04h4nW3PEouwqDAeOrY0A1Kr_HdjwIHUt4iE_z3Y_)_**

clean_body: We are less than a month from the most important midterm elections of our lifetimes. I need you with me. | Fellow American, I want to be honest with you about where we are. We are less than a month from the midterms. And every morning I walk into the Senate, I think about what happens to the work we have done.....the border gains, the judicial nominees, the parental rights wins, if we lose this majority. It does not get preserved. It gets dismantled. I did not run for this seat to watch everything we built get handed back to the people who spent years tearing it down. I ran because I believe that the America my kids inherit depends on what conservatives do right now, in these final weeks, before November closes the door on this moment. Not next week. Now. The window to make a difference is closing faster than most people realize. The Democrats have their money. They have their operatives on the ground in Texas and Iowa and North Carolina. # **[Musk's Tesla Roadster FLIES with SpaceX thrusters ](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Tesla unveiled its long-delayed **[next-generation Roadster](https://substack.com/redirect/f598de9d-6210-4df0-895f-6f5a3b700abe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday at a SpaceX test site in McGregor, Texas, where the two-seater **[used cold-gas thrusters to fly and flip midair](https://substack.com/redirect/f5e1f1f1-2b66-49d9-98e3-fa546e3938b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while claiming **[sub-second zero-to-60 acceleration](https://substack.com/redirect/94700824-2f7f-4de3-8a35-a8bc3410a494?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and fueling merger talk.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Flying demo thrusters** : The white prototype drove upside-down on a curved ramp using a fan suction system that can generate up to 2Gs, then launched off, flipped and landed using 10 SpaceX-designed cold-gas thrusters fed by about 600 liters of compressed air.

CoreWeave's credit default swaps (CDS) **[widened to distressed levels](https://substack.com/redirect/6c636ca0-fd43-42a2-9ef2-a9cc6bdb6ecc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** above 1,000 basis points Thursday as bond yields topped 15%, even as the[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/791bd55b-0d74-4505-a3cf-db110b97d8bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[three co-founders had already sold $3.3 billion in stock](https://substack.com/redirect/791bd55b-0d74-4505-a3cf-db110b97d8bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since the 2025 IPO.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Credit stress details** : Five-year CDS spreads reached as high as 1,140 basis points and last stood near 1,038, while the 2031 notes yielded 15.78% to maturity amid more than $50 billion in debt and obligations.
* **Founder sales** : Michael Intrator, Brian Venturo and Brannin McBee sold $3.3 billion total since the March 2025 IPO, including $2.4 billion this year, yet still hold about 20% of the company.
* **Market reaction** : Shares plunged 15.5% Wednesday then recovered to close Thursday up 5.94%, with **[Nvidia's Jensen Huang saying](https://substack.com/redirect/3a6946e9-f3f2-47f3-8265-9c928ea92e26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** the cost of capital is decreasing and no backstop is needed.
* **Broader AI debt** : Evercore called the market's stance "no mas" to AI debt without operating cash flow support, as Oracle CDS also widened.

# [Buy-the-dip calls ignored as Micron falls under $1,000](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Micron shares fell below $1,000 early Friday amid fears of Chinese competition and AI durability doubts, **[even as analysts called the selloff an overreaction](https://substack.com/redirect/08bb1234-b759-4421-a543-a4285b5a92c9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and urged buying the memory dip ahead of further price gains.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Price and performance** : Shares were down 3.5% at $899.15 in early trading after more than tripling this year and peaking above $1,200 in the summer.
* **Competition and AI doubts** : Investors worried about China's CXMT advancing in conventional server memory and questioned whether the AI boom can last, though CXMT is not seen threatening high-bandwidth memory for AI servers.
* **Analyst support** : Fundstrat's Kent Fung called the CXMT reaction an overreaction and another reason to buy the dip, while KeyBanc's John Vinh reiterated a $1,750 target and said shortages should persist beyond 2028.
* **Pricing outlook** : DRAM prices are expected to rise 15% to 20% in the fourth quarter, with Google considering long-term supply deals through 2035 and Micron remaining one of three major global suppliers.

# [Netflix axes top Content chief after torching 1000 jobs](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Netflix is[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ed4b61ed-c91c-4d6c-b35d-3146888aa8a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[replacing content chief Bela Bajaria](https://substack.com/redirect/ed4b61ed-c91c-4d6c-b35d-3146888aa8a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Peter Rice just days before earnings, after cutting about 1,000 jobs, or 6% of its workforce, and signaling a sharper focus amid slowing growth.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Leadership change** : Bela Bajaria, in the role since 2023 after a decade at the company, exits immediately; Peter Rice, formerly of Disney and Fox, takes over next week.
* **Job cut scope** : The reductions, the largest since 2022, primarily affect product, technology, human resources and legal teams as the company prioritizes resources.
* **Growth context** : Co-CEO Ted Sarandos has said the company is "not growing as fast as I want us to," with shares down sharply over the past year.
* **Timing note** : The moves come ahead of third-quarter results next week and follow a lost bid for Warner Bros. Discovery assets.

# [KFC dumps Pepsi for Coca-Cola after nearly 40 years](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
KFC **[will replace Pepsi with Coca-Cola](https://substack.com/redirect/ad42db53-5bed-469a-ae4f-6a0caef94867?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ad42db53-5bed-469a-ae4f-6a0caef94867?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)at its roughly 3,700 U.S. restaurants by spring 2027, ending a partnership that began when PepsiCo acquired the chain in 1986.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc324-c557-455d-b2d0-ce61b68a6112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Transition timeline** : The switch starts in January 2027, with all U.S. locations expected to complete the change by spring.
* **Partnership history** : The beverage deal continued after PepsiCo spun off KFC in 1997 under Yum! Brands, lasting nearly four decades.
* **Company comments** : KFC President Catherine Tan-Gillespie framed the move as modernizing the chain; Coca-Cola's Dagmar Boggs highlighted pairing with the food menu.
* **International note** : PepsiCo retains the beverage relationship with KFC's international restaurants and other Yum brands such as Taco Bell.

| | | **$366 million, Peter.** That’s how much Elon Musk has spent on the 2026 midterms so far. No one else comes close. **He’s the biggest single donor of the whole cycle. 1** Most of that money came in just the last few months. Since July, he’s given $276 million, including a single _$158 million check_ to a Senate Republican super PAC. **That’s one of the biggest political donations anyone has ever made in U.S. history. 2** The Senate isn’t the only thing he’s after, though. Musk is also funding House Republicans, Republican governors, Republican attorneys general, and right-wing PACs. He’s not trying to win a few races. He’s trying to buy a government that bends to his will at _every_ level. **That’s why these last three weeks matter so much, Peter. If we don’t organize like never before, his money could tip the scales.** [**Can you chip in $10 today to help get out the vote before Election Day?**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9jPphoTQCJapDV5XOZJKRbdJK_xunKMTiHgH2hkFvf-sJaG4GByXzCR6U7hSOGcB7PnG3JwL5c7oesUDw5L7uqYdqD8ZWrt5NCsUkmPo_oIyP1xHQW7Dnm-kUDZvOOQbZPUIUWrgtq8og7LGHdvR9ZVX5Pe7oqJvz07Zxi3o35a9r-hl6hLQ56yMokWEJCCT05GuHxkGZXPXucJ9MTjuWdYEDE7croP8wdCAmbVLsbqH6Ca4QWRHES2y8OLdJKYg2T7ELbF2Nn-gDSa9stjjZT8X4KjG0_jn5DeQAOzS07oMh-_D449BQ5aFagDqwNKtm_rLlHZIZaTjL9mxG5lPObzUhtOinSbXSnw3SvJdjAYc/4ux/bYL8mfMFTtahpjSU2kkHzw/h0/h001.YGprrP-8nVp6Levlz9fBEyvFGZgxj-XKCHrOHLNUync) **[Donate $10 »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9jPphoTQCJapDV5XOZJKRbdJK_xunKMTiHgH2hkFvf-uKlL4vGcvtL3eCCpD3vtwZrfdyXVJ7_cd25Ggym5_wETL_0svFLMkGhMMSYp9E2qb9xaiZEnhGyQcb7NqebNZZa5uYZweZ5X70TLKutmv4uYI2mLMsokrBxtmByeysEjyDBuiRas0nZaiVc9tnfcNs2eAQQj93OysJbnQNXrAjf95Pc9AqdwlVk_vX81BuRxfqI2rwEGjQMUHFlle1vzGtUvN2Ml3dpmvYIkSam_kmoORmfDr0xRadDU945o0AsqzVILvlIxP43MBhsvnN5IEoNKpg7q7i7K86XWeg8HxDjP0x0_NfU-C8p_uShrYsILI/4ux/bYL8mfMFTtahpjSU2kkHzw/h1/h001.6PzwNa_U3c8iUgc3rqr7B8Lb9fooWc25RDpBubpx7ek)** **For the richest man in the world, $366 million barely makes a dent.** What he gets back is worth way more to him: tax breaks for billionaires, regulators who look the other way on his companies, and lawmakers who pick up when he calls. He’s not doing this alone, either. Pennsylvania’s richest man, **Jeffrey Yass** , the crypto-rich **Winklevoss twins** , and a bunch of **AI and Big Tech billionaires** are pouring money into the same corporate, anti-union, special-interest agenda.3 With that much money stacked against us, it’s easy to feel like we can’t compete, Peter. But elections aren’t decided by who writes the biggest checks. They’re decided by who actually shows up to vote, and there are _a lot_ more of us than there are of them. **Getting our people to the polls is exactly what the Working Families Party does. We’re on the ground in races across the country, organizing for 19 congressional champions, including:**
* **Abdul El-Sayed** and **Will Lawrence** in Michigan
* **Randy Villegas** in California
* **Angie Nixon** in Florida**,** who won her primary while being outspent nearly _16 to 1_ 4

**We’re also turning out voters for our state and local candidates,** because Musk is spending at every level and we have to fight back everywhere he does. **And we know this works.** Every single one of our priority candidates was outspent in their primary this year, and they won _anyway_. Because that’s what organizing can do. But doing it again in November is going to take real resources. The **flyers** our canvassers leave with voters at the door cost money. So do the **dialers** that power our phone banks, the **apps** our volunteers use to text voters, and the **ads** we’re running on TV and radio. Every piece of it adds up fast. clean_body: | | | $366 million, Peter. That’s how much Elon Musk has spent on the 2026 midterms so far. No one else comes close. He’s the biggest single donor of the whole cycle. 1 Most of that money came in just the last few months. Since July, he’s given $276 million, including a single $158 million check to a Senate Republican super PAC. That’s one of the biggest political donations anyone has ever made in U.S. history. 2 The Senate isn’t the only thing he’s after, though. Musk is also funding House Republicans, Republican governors, Republican attorneys general, and right-wing PACs. He’s not trying to win a few races. He’s trying to buy a government that bends to his will at every level. That’s why these last three weeks matter so much, Peter. If we don’t organize like never before, his money could tip the scales. For the richest man in the world, $366 million barely makes a dent. What he gets back is worth way more to him: tax breaks for billionaires, regulators who look the other way on his companies, and lawmakers who pick up when he calls. He’s not doing this alone, either. Pennsylvania’s richest man, Jeffrey Yass , the crypto-rich Winklevoss twins , and a bunch of AI and Big Tech billionaires are pouring money into the same corporate, anti-union, special-interest agenda.3 With that much money stacked against us, it’s easy to feel like we can’t compete, Peter. But elections aren’t decided by who writes the biggest checks. They’re decided by who actually shows up to vote, and there are a lot more of us than there are of them. Getting our people to the polls is exactly what the Working Families Party does. We’re on the ground in races across the country, organizing for 19 congressional champions, including: Abdul El-Sayed and Will Lawrence in Michigan Randy Villegas in California Angie Nixon in Florida, who won her primary while being outspent nearly 16 to 1 4 We’re also turning out voters for our state and local candidates, because Musk is spending at every level and we have to fight back everywhere he does. And we know this works. Every single one of our priority candidates was outspent in their primary this year, and they won anyway. Because that’s what organizing can do. But doing it again in November is going to take real resources. The flyers our canvassers leave with voters at the door cost money. So do the dialers that power our phone banks, the apps our volunteers use to text voters, and the ads we’re running on TV and radio. Every piece of it adds up fast. Peter, we’ll never come close to the kind of money Musk is throwing around, and we know that. But we don’t need to match him. We just need enough to reach the voters who will decide these races. Thank you for being part of this movement. In solidarity, always, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. , The Guardian, October 13, 2026. 2\. , The New York Times, October 12, 2026. 3\. , CNBC, October 8, 2026. 4\. , The New York Times , August 18, 2026. name: Nellie Pou
subject: Martin Soto is home with his family
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/115406/images/pout-header-3.png]

Friend,

Last week, Martin Soto walked out of ICE custody and back into the arms of his family.

Martin is an asylum seeker who came to this country in 2024. He has no criminal record. In February, federal agents detained him while he was out buying diapers for his young children. He spent the next eight months locked up.

While he was held at Delaney Hall, the for-profit ICE facility in Newark, Martin helped organize detained immigrants to speak out against the conditions inside. Instead of answering for those conditions, ICE moved him to the Elizabeth Detention Center and kept him in solitary confinement for months.

For months, my office pressed ICE to release him. His wife, Gabby, never stopped fighting. Advocates, faith leaders, and neighbors across New Jersey kept showing up. And finally, after a federal judge ruled his detention unlawful, Martin was set free.

In Congress, I'm going to keep demanding answers from ICE, keep pushing for real oversight of facilities like Delaney Hall, and keep standing with the families who are being torn apart.

Thank you for standing with me.

Onward,

Nellie
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP61/1/115406/images/pou_headshot_crop.jpg]

About Nellie Pou
Nellie Pou is the first Latina to represent New Jersey in Congress, and will be a target for the NRCC in 2026. As a mother and grandmother, Nellie knows what New Jersey families are facing and will continue to bring down costs while creating good-paying jobs. Nellie has dedicated her entire life to the community that raised her, and in Congress she will do the same.

Exactly as I [predicted](https://substack.com/redirect/088ca635-ea25-4b63-86d5-08d140830a22?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) six months ago, the $1.2 billion Democratic omnibus bill Gov. Janet Mills (D) signed back when she was still entertaining a stint in the U.S. Senate has resulted in "stimulus" checks going to noncitizens.
The Maine Wire's Jon Fetherston has obtained photographs of $300 checks sent out by the state of Maine to multiple J-1 Visa holders -- that is, to non-citizens who came to the U.S. to work temporarily through an Exchange Visitor program. The images were provided by a source who was mailed the checks because the intended recipients are no longer present in the U.S.
For less than your share of the cost of the welfare consumed by non-citizens, you can subscribe to The Robinson Report!

The checks reflect precisely what I said back in April when the legislation was released with language that would distribute the $300 payments to "residents" without any requirement that those residents be U.S. citizens.
The implication is that Maine taxpayers may have spent nearly $10 million on stimulus payments for non-citizens. If you trust the "Office of New Americans," they have estimated that there are roughly 16,000 noncitizens working and filing taxes in Maine (not including an additional population of illegal aliens of between 7,000 to 8,000, some of whom may have filed taxes using an Individual Tax Identification Number or ITIN).
Maine Revenue Services mailed $300 checks to full-year Maine residents who filed a 2025 return by October 15, 2026, were not dependents, and were under the income limit. The limits are $50,000 for a single filer, $75,000 for a head of household, and $100,000 for a joint return. Those limits use federal adjusted gross income. Citizenship is not a test. The state has explicitly said an ITIN return can qualify.
Setting aside the population of illegal aliens: If the roughly 16,000 noncitizen tax-filers the Mills Administration claims work and file taxes in Maine, then Maine Democrats have issued nearly $5 million to noncitizens via the $300 checks.

Here’s a quick recap of what’s been going on, Peter:
**First:** After 12 years of Greg Abbott failing our families and selling out our state to the highest bidder, the political landscape has completely shifted in Texas.
**Then:** Six independent polls now show us leading Greg Abbott. Everyday Texans are fed up with skyrocketing utility bills, underfunded public schools, and corrupt leadership.
**Now:** Even Republicans are starting to panic. Behind closed doors, Republicans are openly doubting Abbott’s chances. They know he’s never been this vulnerable in his entire political career.
Terrified of our lead, Abbott has spent _millions_ on attack ads, buying up TV airwaves across Texas to distort my record and drown out our grassroots message.
**[So, Peter, will you rush in $5 today to make sure we continue to have the funds to compete against Abbott's millions? Dear Friend of Life, She can take the pregnancy test at home. **Find the abortion pills at home.** Order them at home. Have the package delivered to her door. And she may go through the abortion **in that same home.** No waiting room. No face-to-face conversation before she makes the decision. Perhaps no one beside her when she goes through what follows. This is how dramatically the abortion pill has changed the fight for life. A woman can be frightened and overwhelmed one moment, reach for her phone the next, and begin moving toward a decision **she cannot undo.** And when the abortion is over, the decision doesn't simply disappear. What happened privately in her home is now something she has to live with. **We want to reach her before she gets there.** PreBorn! partners with pregnancy clinics across the country where women considering abortion can receive free ultrasounds and compassionate support. Before she takes the pill, we want to give her the opportunity to see her baby. To talk with someone about what she's facing. To know abortion isn't her only option. When women see their babies through an ultrasound at a PreBorn! Network Clinic, **80% choose life.** And **$28 can help provide one free ultrasound.**

body:
If you've been waiting for the right moment to get more involved, then this is it.

| [](https://trk.emails.troydowning._ivStMjA)
---
Peter,
It’s Congressman Troy Downing.
I'll be honest with you – there have been moments during this campaign when I genuinely wondered whether enough people out there still cared the way I hoped they would.
But then something happens that restores that faith.
A stranger stops me at an event to say they're praying for this campaign. A volunteer shows up at 7 a.m. to knock doors before their own workday even starts.
[A donor who's never given a dollar to a political campaign in their life decides this is the year they finally do.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._ZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYxMDE2X1BGLTZRLjExMDExN190MjA1OTc2Ny0yODk5JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MTAxNl9QRi02US4xMTAxMTdfdDIwNTk3NjctMjg5OSJ9/760Dm1aK-bWkUdVir387Uw)
Every time that happens, I'm reminded that there really are true Patriots out there – people who still believe their voice and their support matter, even when it feels like the odds are stacked against them.
I'm writing today because I'm hoping you're one of those people – especially with our House Majority on the line.
If you've been waiting for the right moment to get more involved, then this is it. [Please consider chipping in $10, $15, or quite literally any amount today – I promise every cent helps.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._nnz2axbYt-b3v-JgA)

body:
The window to reach more voters with our message is closing.

Peter, as I write this, North Carolinians are already voting.
**If you’ve been waiting for the most impactful moment to make your first donation to my campaign, today is the day.[_We need to raise $500,000 before midnight to reach more voters, so please: Will you chip in right now?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1676&amount=5&t=8&akid=4607%2E124072%2E3f4A22)**
It’s been nearly 20 years since we sent a Democrat to the U.S. Senate from NC. _That’s a long time and it just shows how hard flipping this seat is going to be._
Experts say our campaign is the best chance to change that. Poll after poll shows us surging ahead, thanks to the support of people like you. We’re on the verge of defeating my MAGA opponent, flipping this seat and, with it, the Senate.
However, we can’t take our foot off the gas. I’m still up against Trump’s handpicked candidate – a guy who used to chair the national Republican Party. I’m still being attacked with lies and character smears. I’m still fighting back against my opponent’s constant attacks.
**The only way I can cross the finish line on Nov. 3 and win is with your critical grassroots support. We must reach every last voter in every corner of NC before it’s too late.**

subject: Courage Can Save US Launches in the UK 🇬🇧
body:
| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/wrX6fM9vpkA?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720)
| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/niGug54SZMX?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720)
| | _Photos courtesy of Andrew Parsons / Parsons Media Productions_
---
| | Dear Peter,This week, [_**Courage Can Save US**_](https://us.list-manage.com/VPOxjhbSO7Y?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720) crossed the Atlantic, launching on October 13 at the historic Tower of London.The stories of its ten Americans, who put service ahead of self-interest and principle ahead of politics, found a new audience in Britain, where questions about courage, leadership, and trust in government resonate just as deeply.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/12EzgC63kg7?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720)
| | _L-R: Rt Hon Tom Tugendhat MP, Shadow Foreign Secretary and MP for Tonbridge, Rye Barcott, Co-Founder and CEO of With Honor and author of Courage Can Save US, General Sir Gordon Messenger, Constable of the Tower of London and former Vice Chief of the Defence Staff, Al Carns MP, MP for Birmingham Selly Oak and former Minister for the Armed Forces (Photos courtesy of Andrew Parsons / Parsons Media Productions)_
---
| | **General Sir Gordon Messenger** , Constable of the Tower of London, and the Yeoman Warders welcomed guests to the White Tower. **Nigel Newton** , Founder and Executive Chairman of Bloomsbury Publishing, opened the evening. Rye then joined Admiral Sir Tony Radakin, former Chief of the Defence Staff, for a conversation on courage and service. Lionel Barber, former Editor of the _Financial Times_ , moderated.To mark the launch, With Honor commissioned a [**Focaldata survey**](https://us.list-manage.com/EWhBazO_kx8?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720)[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/eALzdMiYdBE?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720)of 2,176 adults across the UK on national service, both civilian and military. The findings point to a generation more ready to serve than many assume. Six in ten 18-to-24-year-olds said they would join a year-long, paid program with charities, community groups, emergency services, or the armed forces. Most saw it as an opportunity, not an obligation. And 71 percent of all respondents said such a program would make Britain stronger._The Times_ reported on the findings, which are backed by two veterans from opposite sides of the House of Commons. **Al Carns MP** , a Royal Marines reserve officer, is Labour’s former Minister for the Armed Forces. **The Rt Hon Tom Tugendhat MP** , an Army reservist who served in Iraq and Afghanistan, is now the Conservative Shadow Foreign Secretary. Together, they are urging the government to open a path toward a program that would strengthen Britain’s resilience in times of crisis. As Tugendhat told the paper, “giving young people the chance to serve belongs to no single party.” You can read the full article [**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/19ofZOmp9RJ?e=33f53a5b1a&c2id=cb2f151404272f38c482059c4a3ef720).
